name: Gästehaus Lärchenheim
beschreibung: The Gästehaus Lärchenheim in Gerlos is an inn with traditional character. The accommodation is in a quiet location on the outskirts of Gerlos. The surroundings offer access to the hiking and skiing areas of the Zillertaler Alpen. Guests can expect simple, functional furnishings in the rooms. The house has a restaurant with regional cuisine. The atmosphere is characterized by Tiroler hospitality without excessive comfort. Gerlos is a starting point for outdoor activities.
